Despite the growing interest in ET, much fundamental work remains to be done to investigate its metabolism, actions (if any) on the genome, lipidome, metabolome and proteome, intracellular and intercellular transport (especially in the brain), precise mechanisms of cytoprotection, interactions with the microbiome, mycobiome and human pathogens, and identifying the factors that control body ET levels.
